needed_by: Account screen: change own password (frontend-plan.md P0-1)
why: PATCH /api/users/{id} needs users:manage, so a VIEWER or ANALYST cannot change their own password today (fixture PATCH_api_users_2__403_viewer_own_password.json).

detail.msg: String should have at least 8 characters

behaviour: Verifies current_password first; a wrong current password counts toward the login throttle.
On success revokes every session of the caller (as PATCH /api/users/{id} does) and appends auth.password_changed to the audit chain.
frontend_status: mocked in src/mock/resolve.ts; against a backend without the route the Account screen falls back to PATCH /api/users/{id} for users:manage, otherwise explains that the server does not support it yet.
